title: Chapter 106: The Tengu Tribe'S Compromise
content:
Chapter 106: The Tengu Tribe'S Compromise

Gou Yin had a sullen face and reported the alliance's long-term occupation of the alliance's important city to the senior officials on duty in the clan. Both of them felt that the matter was difficult to handle, and sent someone to report it to the clan elder Gou Hong.

The two jointly initiated an emergency meeting and summoned powerful figures in the clan to come for a meeting to discuss.

If they still want to delay this and cause a conflict with the Zerg and trigger a war, then the two of them will be in big trouble.

It didn't take long for some powerful figures from the clan to arrive. The clan would not initiate an emergency meeting unless there was something important within the clan.

"What's the matter? Is it so urgent?"

"It's not clear yet, let's wait until everyone is here!"

"..."

When everyone was almost there, news came from the clan leader Gou Hong. He had only one request, that is, not to start a war with the Zerg now, and let everyone discuss other matters.

"Gou Yin, please introduce the situation to everyone!"

The clan elder didn't come, but all the other people were here. The senior officer on duty asked Gou Yin to explain the situation to everyone.

Gou Yin told the whole story of the matter, especially emphasizing that if he did not give a clear reply today, the alliance would send troops to expel the garrison tomorrow.

"If the alliance sends troops to expel the garrison, it will easily lead to conflict, and possibly a war!"

"This is not in line with the requirements of the clan elders! It is also not in line with the interests of the clan!"

"Let's stop procrastinating today and come up with an idea as soon as possible!"

The senior officer on duty added.

"Gou Yin, is there no room for maneuver at all?"

Someone asked Gou Yin.

"With the support of the Zerg, the lords of the alliance have become very stubborn and have no respect for our clan!"

"Since they have said such words, I am not sure about the lords of the alliance, but based on my understanding of the Zerg, they will definitely fulfill it!"

"In other words, if we don't come up with an idea now, we will face the Zerg army tomorrow!"

"If our troops are forcibly expelled directly, our face will be even worse!"

"If you don't take the clan elder's words to heart, you can mobilize the army and fight the Zerg!"

Gou Yin is very clear about the thoughts of these people here. As long as it is not related to their vital interests, they will not speak out if they can, and they will not express their stance if they can.

No matter what the matter is, as long as it can be delayed, they will delay it. Gou Yin understands this deeply.

If the problem is not explained clearly, the matter will be delayed indefinitely.

"Should we give up this territory or not?"

Gou Yin finally issued a soul torture.

"That territory is not of great value to our clan, but if it is given to that small alliance like this, our clan will lose face!"

"Others think that my huge Tengu clan is afraid of that small alliance!"

"So, if you can't give it to them, don't give it to them! Let's see if there is any good way?"

Everyone knows that pretending to be deaf will not work this time, so some people start talking nonsense mode. Listening to what they say, what they say is equivalent to not saying anything.

"When have we, the Tengu clan, been threatened by others in this area?"

"We must not give up this territory!"

"Gou Yin, go ahead and reject them firmly now. This can be regarded as replying to their message!"

"Are they really going to go to war with us over this?"

This man wanted to play a word game. He still didn't believe that anyone in this area dared to challenge the status of the Tengu clan.

"We must not make this move. Once we compromise with that alliance, our clan's image of absolute dominance in this region will be affected!"

"I suggest gathering an army tomorrow to measure the Zerg's strength head-on!"

"If we start a war within the same camp and let the Evil God camp take advantage, we will take this matter into consideration, and they will definitely take it into consideration as well!"

"We must not show cowardice in this!"

This is a person who has a relatively firm attitude and really talks about some issues, but he is also suspected of not being afraid of big things.

"..."

People kept talking, which made Gou Yin's head grow bigger.

The mainstream opinion was that they could not give in. Everyone was betting that the Zerg tribe would not dare to go to war with the Tengu tribe, but Gou Yin had a hunch in his heart that the Zerg tribe would really dare to fight a war with the Tengu tribe.

"As far as I know, the Zerg are even crazier and more militant than the followers of the evil god. Everyone should know about their performance on the battlefield!"

"If I say that they really dare to fight us, do you still want to stick to your current attitude?"

Gou Yin said coldly.

"Then we will assume a premise that the Zerg are an equal race that dare to fight us. Everyone should consider it carefully before expressing their opinions!"

The senior officer on duty added.

"Then what else is there to say? There is no face issue between the two big clans!"

"Why start a war over such a small gain?"

By bringing the relationship between the two races to an equal footing, everyone will feel balanced, and there will be no issue of giving or not. Both sides want to save face for such a small benefit and will not fight for it.

But in the minds of these senior officials of the Tengu clan, the Zerg clan is not yet up to this level!

Since such a premise has been preset, and the clan elders are unwilling to go to war with the Zerg, everyone has nothing to say.

"Then just give in! What else are we discussing?"

"You decide! I don't have any objections!"

A senior member of the Tengu tribe simply waved his hand, stood up and left.

It seems that leaving the scene directly is also a tradition among the Tengu clan these days.

Seeing that someone had taken the lead, everyone expressed their opinions, saying that they would not object to any decision, and then stood up and left one after another.

After a while, only the senior executive on duty and Gou Yin were left.

An emergency meeting within the Tengu tribe ended just like that. In fact, when the elder Gou Hong decided not to go to war with the Zerg, everyone had nothing to discuss.

There was no choice but to bet that the Zerg would not dare to go to war, but this bet was likely to lose, and everyone did not dare to take this responsibility, so they could only ignore it.

The two looked at each other, and after a long while, the senior executive on duty said to Gou Yin: "Gou Yin, you order in the name of the tribe to withdraw all the garrisons!"

Gou Yin nodded and walked out somewhat dejectedly.

It was a little early now, so he directly issued the order to withdraw the troops and asked the messenger to pass the order.

As for sending a message to the alliance lords waiting there, he could not do it himself, and did not want to send anyone to go.

As long as the army was withdrawn, it would be considered an answer with action. He believed that the alliance lords would not wait for him foolishly.

…

The alliance lords who were eating and drinking saw the messengers of the Tengu clan rushing into the various military camps within the scope of the alliance city. After a while, the Tengu clan troops stationed in the military camps began to organize their troops.

“Will the people of the Tengu clan not besiege us in advance now?”

One lord drank a lot and said to the lords around him with a smile.

“What are you afraid of? We will definitely have no problem fighting back to the city!”

“Haha, they are going to retreat! Relying on these troops to fight us is a dead end!”

“…”

Under the strong watch of the alliance lords, the Tengu clan’s army withdrew from the scope of the alliance city.
